title: PaliGemma 2 mix Release
summary: Google's Gemma release documentation records the release of PaliGemma 2 mix on February 19, 2025, in 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter sizes.
significance: A dated release milestone for PaliGemma 2 checkpoints tuned across a mixture of vision-language tasks for direct exploration and common out-of-the-box uses.

verification.note: Google AI for Developers' first-party Gemma release ledger explicitly records February 19, 2025 as the PaliGemma 2 mix release date and lists 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter sizes. Google's same-day Developers Blog announcement independently identifies the launch and describes the mix checkpoints as tuned to a mixture of tasks for direct exploration and common out-of-the-box uses. This boundary is kept separate from the December 5, 2024 PaliGemma 2 release. No development geography, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
